Observation Details: Observed a large flock of raptors soaring over the San José del Cabo estuary, Baja California Sur, Mexico, on October 28, 2026. Multiple birds were visible simultaneously, gliding high overhead. Based on the birds’ apparent compact build, broad wings, and pale underwings with darker markings, Broad-winged Hawk is the leading identification, consistent with suggestions from other birders reviewing the photographs and video.    Broad-winged Hawks are documented annual fall and winter visitors to the Cape Region, with regional records spanning September 30 through April 17. The large group and soaring behavior are consistent with raptor migration. Individual birds were distant, so the identification is based on the available visual evidence rather than close diagnostic views.
